entries.title: Dust: An Elysian Tail
entries.definitive_edition: Dust: An Elysian Tail on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release; no emulation is needed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native Windows PC presentation with PC capture/settings flexibility.

primary.why: The Windows PC version is the best archive route because it keeps the complete game in a native release with 1080p presentation, broad input support, performance options, and capture/settings flexibility. Later PS4, iOS, and Switch ports provide useful access but no sourced exclusive gameplay content over PC.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Dust: An Elysian Tail on Steam or GOG for Windows PC and play the current native PC build with a controller or preferred PC input setup.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster or content-expanded edition is documented; later console/mobile ports are access routes rather than separate definitive editions.
